**In one line**: The California State University (CSU) system has reportedly renewed its OpenAI partnership under a three-year, $13 million agreement.

### Key points
- CSU is extending its existing OpenAI collaboration via a **three-year, $13M** deal.
- The move continues the rollout of generative AI across university campuses.
- Reported by the Daily Titan, a campus newspaper.

### Why it matters
A large public university system renewing its OpenAI contract signals that campuses are folding generative AI into multi-year infrastructure rather than treating it as a one-off pilot. It marks education as a stable institutional customer base for AI vendors.
